title: Bounded remediation: PAIR_CEO_MODEL operator seam (CEO model configurable like every other route)
description: E2E-V1 remediation: (1) resolveDefaultCeoModelEntry previously resolved a hardcoded gpt-6.1-sol — the only reasoning model in the stack with no operator override. PAIR_CEO_MODEL adds the missing seam: model-id only (provider stays codex-cli — subscription-only transport preserved), malformed value fails closed FAIL_CLOSED_CEO_MODEL_CONFIG before any catalog read, unset/empty keeps the default. No seeding, no qualification bypass — pure resolution seam, mirrors PAIR_CONVERSATION_MODEL. (2) C10 test-harness flake: the dangling-pointer assertion pinned a single wedge code (FAIL_CLOSED_RELATION_INDEX) while the scan's wedge priority is ULID-order-dependent — a corrupt sibling pointer traversed first fires FAIL_CLOSED_ENTITY_HASH_MISMATCH on the identical contract (loud fail-closed wedge, never silent clearing). The assertion now accepts either wedge code; reproduced flaky under parallel workers, stable 3/3 after.
